message.content: Hai! Untuk mengecek status “pants” (pakaian) atau barang lain di sistem kami, saya perlu memastikan bahwa Anda sudah terautentikasi terlebih dahulu. Apakah Anda bersedia memberikan nama pengguna dan kata sandi Anda (atau token login jika sudah ada)? Jika Anda belum memiliki kredensial, beri tahu saya, dan saya akan membantu prosesnya.
message.reasoning: The user says: "Kak, untuk pants itu ready tidak ya". This is Indonesian: "Kak, for pants, is it ready or not?" They likely want to check if pants are ready. We need to authenticate? The user didn't provide credentials. The tool is for authentication. But we don't have username/password. We could ask for credentials. But maybe we can respond: "Maaf, saya tidak dapat memeriksa status tanpa autentikasi." Or we can ask for login. The user might want to check inventory. We need to authenticate first. So we should ask for username/password. Use the function? We can call the function with placeholders? No. We need to ask user for credentials. So respond asking for username and password.
